Hi Charlotte,

My name is Roland Jacobs. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across The Secret of the Moon Dial: A Tale of Turicum while researching new middle-grade releases. I was particularly struck by Kyra's purple cat-like eyes and the broken pocket watch that sets off time slips during an Amethyst Moon, and by the fact that Turicum grew out of the Zürich train station and clock shops you knew during your sabbaticals.

That gave me an idea for a 12-month book marketing roadmap built around the Turicum Tales name: launch-season content now, school and library outreach through the year, and newsletter moments that keep readers ready for the next tale. Steampunk clocks and trains also give you a strong visual thread to repeat everywhere.

I'd be happy to sketch a complimentary one-page outline so you can see the direction I have in mind. Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs
